description: Read ONE attachment. Images are returned as images; text/JSON/CSV/Markdown files as text; PDFs as text plus page images; Word/Excel/PowerPoint/OpenDocument/EPUB as text plus embedded pictures; zip archives as a content listing + local path; other files (video, audio, huge images, legacy .doc/.xls/.ppt) are saved locally and the path returned. attachment is an attachment id or a Mewboard file URL taken from an issue or comment (/api/files/<id>).

attachment.description: attachment id (from list_attachments, get_issue or read_issue)

raw.description: default false: ALSO return the original file untouched as an embedded document (up to 20 MB), for clients that read PDFs / Office files natively

name: read_attachment
